notes: Scale on this sheet: 50 ft = ~169 px. Rice comes down from the NW as a 40 ft diagonal (Tacoma T at the very left edge of the scan, x~223) and turns due south at Gage; the Rice/Gage point (950,1862) sits in the open junction between the diagonal centreline (x~915 at y 1860) and the vertical centreline (x 966), so Rice effectively bends at this intersection. Tacoma (printed 'TACOMA', no suffix; key map 'JUSTIS (TACOMA)') enters from the NE; whatever is SW of Rice is off the sheet, so marked T. Gage, Winkler, Calumet etc. are printed without suffix; 'Street' added. Mason is printed 'MASON (NOT OPENED)' west of Main (40 ft, runs E-W) and continues on the NE side of Main as a diagonal 'MASON 6" W.P.' heading NE; the two legs meet Main ~95 px apart, so recorded as two Main/Mason T points: W leg (2768,626), NE leg (2830,699). Calumet runs from Mason (T, just west of Main) south across Gage to Winkler (T); south of Gage it is drawn the same width with addresses 2200-2216 and a 40' label; north of Gage it is marked '(IMPASSABLE)'. McGrew is printed 'McGREW (NOT OPENED)' on both legs: the N-S leg is 50 ft (x 3484-3665) from Main south past Gage and Winkler to the turn; the E-W leg is printed 40 ft. Between Main and Gage the McGrew opening is crossed by a retaining wall with railing along Gage's north line (y~1767); Main/McGrew point is on Main's centreline at McGrew's centre line. Gage ends at McGrew (east of McGrew is the Main/172 block corner). Excelsior (printed 'EXCELSIOR', ~42 ft, no width label) enters from the east edge and Ts into McGrew one street-width north of McGrew's westward turn. Dorsey (30 ft) runs from Alexander east off the sheet. Alexander (50 ft, not opened) runs from behind the Winkler lots south across McGrew and Dorsey and off the bottom of the drawing (continues on 161). The unnamed 'ALLEY (NOT OPEN)' (~18 ft, x~1425) runs from behind the Winkler lots south off the bottom of the drawing. A long single diagonal line from Rice (525,1133) NE to (1640,445) is a property/coverage line, not a street. Huntington Place (printed 'HUNTINGTON PL.') leaves Main to the NE.
